recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core edit is needed for FHIR-5708; future work should use the later clinicalStatus/verificationStatus issue family rather than re-opening the removed Condition.status name.
issue_request: FHIR-5708 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care request to rename Condition.status because its provisional/working/confirmed/refuted values did not align with the usual lifecycle meaning of status; the resolution directed readers to GForge change #3976.
initial_application: The issue was applied through the #3976 Condition status work. Git commit 1f32e2833bae9fb8cc45636c39142020e353b5c6 is explicitly titled '#3976 - rename Condition.status to Condition.clinicalStatus' and changed the Condition source and related artifacts after the PC WG decision recorded in FHIR-3976.
additional_context: FHIR-3976 records the PC WG motion to rename status to clinical status and remove certainty. FHIR-5734 was a related request to eliminate Condition.status but was Resolved - No Change and also points to #3976. Later Published Condition issues, especially FHIR-7581 and duplicate-family FHIR-7864, split the post-rename concepts into clinicalStatus and verificationStatus, explaining why the current source differs from the original 2015 wording while still satisfying the seed's concern that Condition.status was misnamed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Condition is active in source/fhir.ini, source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml defines Condition.clinicalStatus and Condition.verificationStatus, the Condition search parameters target clinical-status and verification-status, and a search under source/condition found no Condition.status element or path remaining to rename.
